task.instruction: Find a gaming desktop with Windows 11 Home, and the disk size should be 1TB.

final_answer:
I searched Amazon for gaming desktops and applied the filters Hard Drive Size: 1 TB and Operating System: Windows 11 Home. The page confirms "Selected filters: 1 TB, Windows 11 Home".

The results include:
- Skytech Gaming PC Desktop, Ryzen 7 5700, RTX 5060, 16GB RAM, 1TB SSD (MYR 4,871.96, 4.3 stars, 308 ratings)
- HP OMEN 40L Gaming Desktop PC, AMD Ryzen 7 5700X, 32GB RAM, 1TB NVMe SSD (4.4 stars, 173 ratings)
- CyberPowerPC Gaming PC, AMD Ryzen 7 8700F, GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 8GB (MYR 6,089.96)
- iBUYPOWER Element Gaming PC Desktop Computer, AMD Ryzen 9 7900X (MYR 9,337.96)
- Lenovo Legion Tower 5-2026, RTX 5070 Ti (MYR 11,694.55)
- Sponsored STGAubron Gaming PC Desktop models with RTX 2060, from about MYR 2,435.96 to MYR 3,008.42

The filtered results page is still open in your browser. I haven't opened any individual listing to check its specs, so confirm the details on the product page before buying.

judge.rationale: Final page URL has filters for 1 TB and Windows 11 Home, and results show gaming desktops with 1TB SSD and Windows 11 Home.
